title: The road so far.
subtitle: Two companies, three and a half years, and software that real businesses run on every day — not tutorials, not side projects.

items.summary: Full stack developer across a portfolio of production SaaS products for logistics and service-industry clients — working end to end from database and API design through React, Next.js, and React Native clients to cloud deployment.
highlights: Own delivery end to end: data architecture, APIs, web and mobile clients, and the deploy pipeline behind them.
Build for regulated, revenue-carrying environments where an outage is an operational and legal problem, not a bug ticket.
Ship with end-to-end Playwright coverage so releases go out without holding anyone's breath.

projects.name: TMS — Transport Management System
projects.body: A transport platform (web console + React Native driver app) running a UK operator's dispatch, fleet, and driver operations, engineered to meet strict UK/EU transport compliance law — drivers' hours, tachograph records, and vehicle inspections. Delivered live GPS tracking, automated driver-hours compliance alerts, and real-time dispatcher–driver chat over WebSockets, replacing manual paperwork with live operational visibility. Every driver-hours, inspection, and defect record is fully auditable, so the system holds up under real regulatory scrutiny.

projects.name: TGM — Totalsoft Garage Manager
projects.body: A multi-tenant SaaS platform for garages to manage customers, vehicles, invoices, quotes, and appointments, with tenant data isolation enforced at the architecture level so new paying customers onboard with zero risk of cross-tenant exposure. Automated invoicing, document storage, and SMS notifications, plus a self-signup marketing site and full end-to-end Playwright test coverage.

projects.name: Totalsoft Platform Console
projects.body: A product-agnostic billing and governance console managing tenants, subscriptions, and access across every Totalsoft SaaS product — onboarding a new product takes a configuration entry rather than new code. Implemented fully audited role-based access control for approving, suspending, and billing tenants, and integrated Direct Debit billing with live webhook-driven payment events.

items.summary: Built the backend and two web apps — an Admin Panel and a Report Panel — running a national volunteer organization's operations across India, on a shared single sign-on across subdomains.
highlights: Designed a Spring Boot backend modeling the full org hierarchy (zones, branches, teams, roles) with a tiered permission engine: 5 role tiers, dozens of individually gated permissions, and full grant/revoke audit history.
Delivered member management with Aadhaar OCR verification and real-time, exportable (PDF/Excel) analytics dashboards drilling down by zone and branch.
Added real-time chat, push notifications, and email alerts to keep volunteers and branch leadership in sync across the organization.
Ran a shared single sign-on across subdomains so one identity works everywhere in the platform.
